A capture with no keyframes lists its app events as
lines. With no app events either, it prints the whole transcript in quotes.
A keyframe line starts with the keyframe number, which is the number in the corner chip of its image, and its time. A line takes one of these four forms:

- #N (M:SS) ⟨<screen>⟩ “<words said>”
- #N (M:SS) ⟨<screen>⟩ [<click>] “<words said>”
- #N (M:SS) ⟨<screen>⟩ ⚑ “<words said>”
- #N (M:SS) ⟨<screen>⟩ ⚑ <event>
  · M:SS app: <label>
  · M:SS <key> → <value>
  · M:SS <key> cleared
Each part of a keyframe line comes from the keyframe itself or from the screens, marks and events around it.
appears when the screen that the app named differs from the last screen the summary showed. ScrawlKit apps name their screens.
marks a keyframe cut on a flag, a marker of a moment with no ink.

. A keyframe without words shows its
line is an app event or a context change from the keyframe's time to the next keyframe. The last keyframe takes every later one, and the ones before the first keyframe go above it.
says how keyframes are chosen and which words each one owns.

writes the text of each keyframe. The words before the first mark or event stay on the keyframe line. Each mark, or each run of events with no words between them, starts an indented line that the next words follow:

fields.name: version
fields.description: Manifest version. The capture and import code writes `1`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The capture id, the folder name without `.scrawl`. `scrawl appshot` and `scrawl measure` accept it.

fields.name: createdAtMs
fields.description: Unix time in milliseconds.

fields.name: durationMs
fields.description: Length of the capture in milliseconds, with pauses cut out. Every other time in the manifest counts from its start.

fields.name: target
fields.description: What was recorded: the mode, the app and the frame.

fields.name: transcript
fields.description: The words, with segment and word times.

fields.name: note
fields.description: A note given at capture or import. The summary prints it as `Note:`.

fields.name: strokes
fields.description: Raw ink, laser and pin strokes.

fields.name: marks
fields.description: Strokes grouped and classified by shape.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Clicks, drags, scrolls, points, keys, app changes and app events.

fields.name: keyframes
fields.description: The chosen frames in time order.

fields.name: contactSheet
fields.description: Relative path of the contact sheet, `contact-sheet.png`.

fields.name: video
fields.description: Relative path of the movie, such as `recording.mp4`.

fields.name: videoOffsetMs
fields.description: When the movie starts on the bundle clock. Video time is bundle time minus this.

fields.name: audio
fields.description: Relative path of the audio, `audio.wav`.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the pictures came from when it is not this Mac's screen: `iphone`.

fields.name: device
fields.description: The phone behind an iPhone bundle.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Values a ScrawlKit app set with `Scrawl.context` when the recording started.

fields.name: contextChanges
fields.description: Changes to `context` during the recording: `t`, `key` and `value`, which is null when the key was cleared.

fields.name: screens
fields.description: The screen a ScrawlKit app said it was on, as `t0`, `t1` and `name` spans.

fields.name: windows
fields.description: Screen and Area modes: the on-screen windows over time, front to back, stored only when they change.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: Screen and Area modes: the cursor at up to 15 Hz while it moves, as `[t, x, y]`.

fields.name: autocrop
fields.description: Screen mode: how each keyframe was cropped.

fields.name: destination
fields.description: The OpenCode session that a dev-site capture went to, so `scrawl send` recovers to the same place.

props.name: ScrawlBundle

fields.name: mode
fields.description: One of `display` (Screen), `window`, `region` (Area) or `device`, a phone's own screen.

fields.name: app
fields.description: App name. The summary header shows it, else `Display`.

fields.name: bundleId
fields.description: The app's bundle id.

fields.name: windowTitle
fields.description: The captured window's title after the privacy policy. The summary header prints it.

fields.name: windowId
fields.description: The window server's window id, for a Window capture.

fields.name: displayId
fields.description: The display that was recorded. `0` for a phone.

fields.name: frame
fields.description: `x`, `y`, `width` and `height` in points, and `scale` in pixels per point.

props.description: The transcript. Transcription owns how each transcriber fills it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The transcriber, such as `deepgram:nova-3`, `hex:<model>` or `command:<name>`.

fields.name: model
fields.description: The model name, when the transcriber gives one.

fields.name: text
fields.description: All the words as one string.

fields.name: segments
fields.description: Utterances as `t0`, `t1` in ms and `text`.

fields.name: words
fields.description: One entry per word: `t0`, `t1` in ms and `text`.

fields.name: estimated
fields.description: `true` when word times were spread over detected speech, not measured. Keyframe selection then skips spoken cues.

fields.name: missing
fields.description: Why there is no transcript although there was audio.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: One plain sentence. The summary prints it as `No transcript:`.

fields.name: retry
fields.description: `true` when Scrawl transcribes the bundle again once the speech model is installed.

props.name: TranscriptData

props.description: One stroke of ink, laser or a pin, as recorded.

fields.name: t0
fields.description: Start in ms on the bundle clock.

fields.name: t1
fields.description: End in ms on the bundle clock.

fields.name: fw
fields.description: Width of the frame the stroke was drawn on.

fields.name: fh
fields.description: Height of the frame the stroke was drawn on.

fields.name: on
fields.description: What the stroke was drawn on, from app state, such as `button “Area”`.

fields.name: pin
fields.description: The pin number for a ⇧-click pin, 1, 2, 3 in drop order.

fields.name: laser
fields.description: `true` for a laser trail.

fields.name: pts
fields.description: Flat triples `[x, y, dt_ms, …]`. `x` and `y` run from 0 to 10000 of the target, and `dt_ms` counts from `t0`.

props.name: Stroke

props.description: Strokes grouped into one gesture. A pause over 1.2 s or a 7th stroke starts a new mark.

fields.name: id
fields.description: `m1`, `m2` and on. `scrawl zoom --mark m2` takes it.

fields.name: strokes
fields.description: Indexes into `strokes`.

fields.name: t0
fields.description: Start in ms.

fields.name: t1
fields.description: End in ms.

fields.name: boxNorm
fields.description: Bounding box `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`. For a circle with a lead-in or tail, the loop alone.

fields.name: shape
fields.description: One of `circle`, `underline`, `line`, `arrow`, `tap`, `pin`, `mark` or `flag`.

fields.name: from
fields.description: An arrow's shaft start.

fields.name: to
fields.description: An arrow's tip.

fields.name: pin
fields.description: The pin number that the images and the summary show.

fields.name: on
fields.description: What the mark was drawn on, from app state.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Plain words for the mark, such as `circled region x 0.28–0.69, y 0.39–0.84`.

fields.name: frame
fields.description: The keyframe image that draws this mark's ink.

props.name: Mark

props.description: A tagged union. `kind` names the variant, and each variant has its own fields.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The variant.

fields.name: t
fields.description: Time in ms on the bundle clock. Every variant has it.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Only for click, scroll and point. Horizontal position.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Only for click, scroll and point. Vertical position.

fields.name: button
fields.description: Only for click and drag. `touch` for a finger on a phone.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Only for click, drag, scroll, point and app_event. What the input landed on, or the app's own text for app_event.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Only for click. The Accessibility role from app state.

fields.name: t1
fields.description: Only for drag. End time in ms.

fields.name: x0
fields.description: Only for drag. Start position, with `y0`, `x1` and `y1`.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Only for drag. Positions between the ends, for drawing the trail.

fields.name: dx
fields.description: Only for scroll. Scroll amount, with `dy`.

fields.name: shortcut
fields.description: Only for key. Such as `⌘K`.

fields.name: app
fields.description: Only for app_change. The app switched to, with an optional `windowTitle`.

props.name: InteractionEvent

props.description: One chosen frame, in time order.
props.example:
{
  "index": 1,
  "t": 3631,
  "reason": "mark",
  "file": "frames/frame-01.png",
  "event": "circled region x 0.28–0.69, y 0.39–0.84",
  "said": "This header is too tall.",
  "markId": "m1"
}

fields.name: index
fields.description: The number from 1 that the image chip and the summary's `#N` show.

fields.name: t
fields.description: Time in ms on the bundle clock.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why it was cut: `mark`, `click`, `laser`, `scene_change`, `speech` or `initial`.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Relative path of the image, `frames/frame-XX.png`.

fields.name: event
fields.description: Plain words for the moment. The summary shows it when `said` is empty.

fields.name: said
fields.description: The words this keyframe owns.

fields.name: markId
fields.description: The mark it was cut for. A shared keyframe names its first mark.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: Cursor position. In the top-left corner it moves the number chip to the top right.

fields.name: appshot
fields.description: The app shot file in `appshots/` of the window this keyframe shows.

props.name: Keyframe

props.description: How a Screen capture's keyframes were cropped.

fields.name: label
fields.description: App names for the `Cropped to:` line, never window titles.

fields.name: fullFrames
fields.description: The folder of uncropped keyframes, `frames-full`.

fields.name: fullContactSheet
fields.description: The uncropped sheet, `contact-sheet-full.png`.

fields.name: crops
fields.description: One per keyframe, in keyframe order.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The keyframe number.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Crop left edge in capture points, with `y`, `width` and `height`.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: One of `window`, `windows`, `focus`, `activity`, `fallback` or `full`.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Plain words for the choice, such as `Electron (100% of the activity)`.

fields.name: apps
fields.description: The apps inside the crop.

fields.name: changes
fields.description: Per keyframe, the regions `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` that changed since the one before. They are one input to the crop.

props.name: AutocropInfo

props.description: One entry of the window log. Auto-crop and app shots read it.

fields.name: t
fields.description: Time in ms.

fields.name: windows
fields.description: The on-screen windows, front to back.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The window server's window id.

fields.name: app
fields.description: App name.

fields.name: regular
fields.description: Written only as `false`, for agent apps such as menu-bar utilities and overlays.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Window title. It never goes into the summary or the clipboard.

fields.name: bounds
fields.description: `[x, y, width, height]` in points from the capture's top-left corner. Can be negative.

fields.name: layer
fields.description: `0` for normal windows, `20` for the Dock, `24` for the menu bar, up to `101` for panels and pop-up menus.

fields.name: frontmost
fields.description: `true` for the frontmost app's frontmost normal window.

props.name: WindowSnapshot

props.description: The phone behind an iPhone bundle. iPhone and ScrawlKit owns how it is filled.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Device name. It replaces the app in the summary header.

fields.name: capture
fields.description: `mirror` for a cabled capture, `scrawlkit` for an in-app SDK recording.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Native video width in pixels.

fields.name: height
fields.description: Native video height in pixels.

fields.name: screen
fields.description: Screen width and height in points, and the scale, when the recording says.

fields.name: app
fields.description: The recorded app.

fields.name: appVersion
fields.description: The app's build.

fields.name: appShortVersion
fields.description: The marketing version, `CFBundleShortVersionString`.

props.name: DeviceInfo

props.description: The OpenCode session a dev-site capture went to. Delivery recovery reads it before any resend.

fields.name: session
fields.description: The session id.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The session title. The `For session:` line shows the id when it is empty.

fields.name: via
fields.description: `sdk` when the page registered through `/sdk.js`, `localhost` when the port's process directory matched.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The browser tab, without its query, fragment and login.

fields.name: directory
fields.description: The project directory that chose the session.
